analysis:

No executable workflow behavior changes here.
Reviewed surrounding cache restore/save conditions, pinned actions, credential-free checkout, product handoff, native admission/media/cache tests, coverage and diagnostic uploads, and the success/intentional-skip gate (base lines 1146–1229). These changes do not alter attestation or build qualification (A-017/T-054), availability (A-018), plaintext handling, billing, or prefix-cache isolation/encryption (T-041). No supported security regression was identified in this file.
Integration should compare the revised comments with any changes to .github/workflows/provider-plan.yml and scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py: runner selection and approval validation are outside this supplied source scope. This comment-only review does not establish those implementations or deployments as safe.
